# Fish Vault: Archival Ichthyology & Specimen Vault

> Digital taxonomic archive and procedural fish synthesis engine. A high-end specimen vault for archival field plates, vector line-art, and plotter coordinates.

## Key Pages
- [Root](https://fish-vault.glassgallery.my.id/): Archival Ichthyology Synthesis Engine and Specimen Vault
